newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai police seize Hong Kong man for drugs.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai police seize Hong Kong man for drugs.

text.p: Shanghai police have arrested a Hong Kong man found selling the designer drug ecstasy in an entertainment establishment in the city, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.
The agency quoted a senior police official as saying that more than 120 illegal pills of MDMA and MDA, often known as ecstasy on the street, were discovered on the man in a raid on February 15.
It was the first-ever case of such drugs being found in China, the agency said.
A police spokesman declined to comment on any aspect of the case, including the arrested man's name.
